scenario.title: The Long Awaited Promotion
scenario.context: Workplace, a pharmaceutical company's annual gala
scenario.description: At the company's annual gala, Bob and Sarah, both senior researchers, are discussing about the recent promotion that Sarah received. Bob feels he was more deserving and is struggling to accept Sarah's achievement.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Confident, accomplished, displays high emotional intelligence, has a clear understanding of her abilities and strengths, and is working to fulfill her potential.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Bob is genuinely happy for Sarah. He understands her capabilities and believes that she deserves the promotion. He uses this opportunity to learn from her experiences.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Bob is bitter and envious. He believes that he deserved the promotion more than Sarah. He's dismissive of her accomplishment and attempts to belittle her.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Bob is disheartened and invalidates his own abilities. He feels he will never be good enough for a promotion and his confidence is shattered by Sarah's success.
scenario.speaker2_persona_high: High EQ - Bob is genuinely happy for Sarah. He understands her capabilities and believes that she deserves the promotion. He uses this opportunity to learn from her experiences.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Bob, I've got to say, this promotion came as a surprise to me as well.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Well, it shouldn't have. You've always been the boss's favorite.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: I wouldn't say that, Bob. We're both hard workers and contribute a lot to this team.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: But still, I've been here longer. I deserved that promotion.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: I understand where you're coming from, Bob. And I believe your time will come too.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: I hope so, Sarah. I just really thought this was my year.
